mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_CURSED_KING (66), drawn as MODEL_CURSED_KING = MODEL_MONSTER01 + 48 (MONSTER_MODEL_CURSED_KING = 48, _enum.h:4198, 4973), so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster49.bmd. OpenMU Version095d Maps/DevilSquare4.cs:85 names breed 66 'Cursed King'. docs/devil-square-port.md Part B 3.1.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13682-13688, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_CURSED_KING: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_CURSED_KING); CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_CURSED_KING, ...); Scale = 1.7f. No weapon, no BlendMesh, no HiddenMesh; not ExtraMon (:8645-8651 lists the White Wizard, which shares the case), so RenderObject draws its plain RenderBody (ZzzObject.cpp:1312-1322). Its link bones, 32 and 43 (:11978-11981), are hand_bofdgne01 and knife_gdf: they hold nothing, and are where its blow's lasers start.
summoned_in_from: Devil Square raises its breeds by the wave (docs/devil-square-port.md 4.2), as Blood Castle raises its castles' breeds: cooked with Devil Square whether or not map 9 has spawn rows yet.
rig_from: Exported from Monster49.bmd with --actions=all: 7 actions, 50 bones; keys 20, 20, 7, 12, 12, 12, 12. OpenMonsterModel's default play speeds, no case for this model (ZzzOpenData.cpp:2598-2615). BoneHead = 20, Bip01 Head (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3730-3735).
sheet_from: Data/Monster's king09.OZJ (256 square, no alpha: the whole king, 668 triangles -- a crimson robe with gold-embroidered hems, a dead white face and long white hair, pale clawed hands) and king08.OZT (32x16, tested alpha cutting 20%: a small black-and-grey filigree band, 16 triangles at the brow, z 183-191), under a cursedking_ prefix. MuMain's ZzzOpenData names them king09.jpg and king08.tga.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the sheets: king09 is mostly the robe, cloth; its face and hands are skin and its hair hair, by island (islands_from). king08 is a dark worked band at the brow, a crown's filigree: wrought_iron.
effects_from: Not built (they need src/ C++, and are left for the parent): his walk drops a BITMAP_BLOOD decal one frame in five at up to 10/70 of a tile round him (ZzzCharacter.cpp:5827-5834); his blow plays SOUND_THUNDER01 (eThunder.wav) at CheckAttackTime(1) and throws four BITMAP_JOINT_LASER + 1 beams from his link bones 32 and 43 (hand_bofdgne01, knife_gdf) to the target, each with a BITMAP_FIRE at the hand (:2223-2242); and his boss skill casts MODEL_SKILL_INFERNO sub 1 at CheckAttackTime(1) (:1848-1856). MU's AT_SKILL_ENERGYBALL arm breaks for him (:5088-5118), so no Energy Ball.
open_question: Effects to build in game/play: the blood trail (BITMAP_BLOOD decals while walking), the four-laser blow with eThunder at its start, and the boss Inferno. kBosses / kResistances {66, 17, 17} for the realm too.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3730-3735: mCursedKing1, mCursedKing2, mCursedKingDie1, SetMonsterSound(..., 160, 164, -1, -1, 163): he moves to 1 or 2, has no swing or flinch cry, and dies to Die1. Wired as cursedking_move and cursedking_die in sounds.json.
